subject: general
question:
Read the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bb33019d2e80612b3487a4ef6a2c90db9027e646c1b3fd2e98f841905ddc9e0.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic:** The number at the bottom is the difference of the square of both the upper numbers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a516b46afa69af70434409ea0f01cff6d78fd6d791c999a263c69d15c984e67d.png] 

→ 32 = (6)² - (2)² = (36 - 4)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d33a4d4120c8cb9687052380b081f41cb532073dd87a3b690f59aaf569dfcda9.png] 

→ 45 = (9)2 - (6)2 = (81 - 36)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecb3ceaf71ccf4e5cc2caa505a3ace641a216f09d80891f1b7df5b81e67b2b5c.png] 

→ 15 = (4)2 - (1)2 = (16 - 1)

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b09a4131a8bcb027cbb41f3434b9e4902404c3fbab2a6aecb84874e59adab0ff.png] 

→ ? = (8)2 - (6)2 = (64 - 36) = 28

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
